title: Feysa and Kipruto triumph in swift Chicago races – World Athletics
claims: World Athletics describes the 11 October 2026 Bank of America Chicago Marathon as a World Athletics Platinum Label road race.
Hawi Feysa retained the title in 2:13:33, with Sharon Lokedi second in 2:14:07 and Brigid Kosgei third in 2:14:55.
The report says it was the first marathon in history in which three women finished inside 2:15.
Amos Kipruto won the men's race in 2:01:09, with Tadese Bikila second in 2:02:56, Milkesa Mengesha third in 2:03:46 and Jacob Kiplimo fourth in 2:04:18.
Emma Grace Hurley's 2:20:47 was the fastest-ever marathon debut by a US woman.
The report does not restate the course distance or publish an elevation figure.
